tools.name: problem.schedules.cancelSchedule
tools.description: Finishes a live schedule, clearing its deadline, so it no longer counts toward max; it stays, finished, for its latest run's report and a read. A finished one is answered unchanged.

tools.name: problem.schedules.listSchedules
tools.description: Lists the row's schedules by name in code point order, live and finished; with name, only that one.

tools.name: problem.schedules.pauseSchedule
tools.description: Pauses an active schedule: it keeps its next run and the retry of its latest one, and its deadline is cleared until it resumes. A paused one is answered unchanged.

tools.name: problem.schedules.reportRun
tools.description: Records the outcome of a schedule's latest run, one of the config's outcomes. The config's retry outcome tries the run again afterMs on, as its next attempt, unless the next regular run comes first; another outcome cancels a retry armed for it. A report of an older run, of a replaced schedule's latest run, or of an attempt other than the latest, or a repeat of the outcome recorded, is answered unchanged.

attempt.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

run.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

tools.name: problem.schedules.resumeSchedule
tools.description: Resumes a paused schedule, arming its next run, or the retry of its latest, again: one past its time falls due at once and fires once. An active one is answered unchanged; a row in a state endOn names resumes none.

tools.name: problem.schedules.setSchedule
tools.description: Sets a schedule of the row by its name: exactly one of after, every and cron, of a kind the config's kinds take, within minMs and maxMs, a cron line read in timeZone. A live schedule of the name is replaced and its runs start again; one with the same kind, spec and time zone is answered unchanged. A new name needs room under max, and a row in a state endOn names takes none.

after.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

every.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

tools.name: problem.status.transition
tools.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.
